title: 2024 Topps Chrome Gavin Stone X Fractor #USC75 Dodgers
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2024 Topps Chrome trading card features Gavin Stone, a player for the Los Angeles Dodgers, with a card number of USC75. The card is a parallel/variety X-Fractor and is an original licensed reprint by Topps. It is a standard size sports trading card for Major League Baseball (MLB) fans and collectors. 

The card is not autographed and was manufactured in the United States in 2024. It is a part of the 2024 Topps Chrome set and is an insert with special features. This card is perfect for anyone who loves baseball and wants to add a unique card to their collection.
